source.title: EnChroma glasses
source.content: A mildly colorblind US competitor is trying out special glasses for the colorblind called [EnChroma](http://enchroma.com/) that block out some parts of the color spectrum. It has been decided that these glasses are not likely to offer an unfair advantage, and should be allowed under the current Regulations.

translation.title: EnChroma 眼镜
translation.content: 一名轻度色盲的美国选手正在试用名为 [EnChroma](http://enchroma.com/) 的特殊色盲眼镜，其作用是滤除部分光谱。经决定，此类眼镜不太可能带来不公平优势，应根据现行规则允许使用。
